fields: fixed PP cost per rank equals tier multiplied by baseCost

costModel.evidence: All 102 native node structs store baseCost 1. Two independent local save deltas equal the sum of purchased node tiers (19 PP and 15 PP).

dependencyModel.rule: Nodes have no per-node prerequisite field or dependency edge; access is gated by the tier spent threshold.

layout.rule: Filter native constructor order by tier, then fill rows left to right.
